intro: The Control Console Operating Manual is a technical document detailing how to operate the machinery at the Venture Company research site southwest of Sludge Fen. It contains instructions needed to safely shut down the valves and disengage the mysterious contraption known as a samophlange.

p: The Venture Company operates a secluded drilling and research site in the northern Barrens, southwest of Sludge Fen. In typical goblin fashion, their complex machinery runs on an erratic array of gauges, pressurized valves, and interconnected mechanisms designed to harness a device called a samophlange. Without proper operating procedures, manipulating such volatile contraptions risks catastrophic backfire or complete system lockouts. This operational manual outlines the precise sequence of valve manipulation required to disengage the core apparatus safely without triggering an explosive failure.
